notes: Wave 1 of EVENT-PROCESSING-SPEC.md. Yesterday's release shipped the disclosure and the record and deliberately contained no engine. This one ships the language — and it is still not the engine. There is no rule store, no tick loop, no action vocabulary, no paper book and no backtester. What exists now is the thing all of those will be written in: a condition tree whose leaves are the predicates this system already speaks, whose internal nodes are the temporal operators Complex Event Processing actually requires, and whose every leg carries its point-in-time verdict before anything is believed.
